Selling and trading in your truck

items.question: How do I find out what my truck is worth?
items.answer: Submit the valuation form with your truck’s year, make, model, mileage and condition. A team member reviews the details and contacts you. A final figure may depend on an in-person inspection.

items.question: What types of trucks can I sell?
items.answer: Tell us about your truck in the form, including Freightliner, Western Star, Autocar or other makes. Our team confirms which trucks we can purchase when they follow up.

items.question: What information do I need to provide?
items.answer: The VIN, year, make, model, mileage and overall condition help most. Photos and notes about recent service or known issues are also useful.

items.question: Can I trade in my truck toward another one?
items.answer: Yes. Mention in the notes field that you are interested in a trade-in, and a team member can discuss it alongside new or used truck inventory and financing options.

items.question: Do I have to bring my truck to a dealership?
items.answer: The form is the first step. Whether an inspection is needed, and where it takes place, is discussed when a team member contacts you.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: Truck Country / Stoops operates dealerships in Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Ohio and Wisconsin. See the locations page to find the one nearest you.
